id.description: Stable id of the meeting note whose transcript to fetch.

include_metadata.description: Include meeting metadata (duration, speaker count, decisions) in the response.

limit.description: Max transcript segments per page (segments are ordered by start time).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination token from a prior response's page.next_cursor.

NoteId.description: Stable note identifier, e.g. "n_a1b2c3". Generated at creation, never rewritten on move/re-route. This is the write handle.
